text:
maria: Heads-up: helm upgrade for gpu-nodepool v2.4.1 failed in us-west-2 during pre-upgrade hook. ArgoCD paused the app. Need help.

deploy-bot: release-job 'pre-upgrade-drain' failed: pod crashed. Logs:
```
panic: webhook: timeout waiting for response
2026-03-18T10:14:03Z ERROR controller-runtime.manager failed to start webhook server: listen tcp :9443: bind: address already in use
```

leo: what's the hook doing? draining nodes? any CRD ops touched?

ashley: The pre-upgrade job patches our gpupool CRD (scale/annotation). The autoscaler webhook is rejecting patches: `admission webhook "gpupool-webhook.redwood.ai" denied the request: cert expired` :grimacing: 

sam: ArgoCD stuck on 'Synced -> OutOfSync -> Paused' because CRD resource is Terminating. `kubectl get gpupool -A` shows gpupool 'usw2-gpu-pool' STATUS=Terminating with finalizer `gpupool.finalizers.redwood.ai`.

maria: Confirmed. New nodepool didn't get provisioned; existing nodes still cordoned. High-priority batch jobs are queueing. Cost note: we had to spin up fallback instances in another account (on-demand) — will show on next invoice.

leo: Two options: 1) restart webhook deployment (less destructive), 2) remove finalizer to force-delete and re-create. Prefer restart first.

ashley: Agreed. If we remove finalizer we risk orphaning cloud resources. Safe patch command if we must:
```
kubectl patch gpupool usw2-gpu-pool -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge
```
But only after disabling the gpupool-controller to avoid racing.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance window for kube-system components at 02:00 UTC — this will affect restarts outside window.

sam: Another option: `kubectl rollout restart deployment gpupool-webhook -n redwood-system` should reload certs from the cert-manager. Try that first.

maria: I'll do the rollout restart now in us-west-2. If it doesn't fix patch acceptance in 10m, I'll present the finalizer patch plan and get a :thumbsup: to proceed.

leo: :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Note: if we force-delete the CRD object and then reapply from helm, helm upgrade might attempt to recreate resources and fail because hooks already ran. Keep helm rollback in mind. Previous stable release is v2.4.0.

maria: Plan: 1) rollout restart webhook 2) re-run pre-upgrade job 3) if still failing, disable gpupool-controller, patch finalizer, re-run helm upgrade 4) re-enable controller and watch for orphaned cloud resources. I'll open a follow-up ticket (JIRA-1234) and add a short runbook.

ashley: Also let's add a readiness check in our ArgoCD/helm pipeline to verify webhook certs and CRD health before running hook jobs.

maria: Thanks all — updating thread as I progress. Will paste commands/output here.
